items.t: Head gasket leak on the 4.5L six
items.job: Replace head gasket, resurface cylinder head and replace head bolts
items.note: Machine shop work on a warped head adds cost. Many owners do the water pump and hoses at the same time.

items.t: Front axle knuckle seals leak grease or gear oil
items.job: Rebuild front steering knuckles with new seals, bearings and grease (both sides)

items.t: Rusted heater pipe leaks coolant
items.job: Replace rear heater pipe and hoses, refill coolant

items.t: Power steering leaks from the reservoir or pump
items.job: Replace power steering reservoir seals or pump
items.note: The low end is reservoir seals only; the high end is a new pump.

items.t: Water leaks from clogged sunroof drains
items.job: Clear sunroof drain tubes and reseal window trim

items.t: Frame cracks near the steering box
items.job: Weld frame cracks and install steering box reinforcement plate

items.t: Rust on the rear body, tailgate and frame
items.job: Treat rust and weld in repair sections
items.note: Cost depends heavily on how far the rust has spread.

items.t: Brake booster or ABS pump fails and the pedal goes hard
items.job: Replace hydraulic brake booster pump/accumulator or ABS actuator
items.note: Owners report bills of roughly $2,700 to $3,100 at dealers.

items.t: Timing belt and water pump past due
items.job: Replace timing belt, water pump, tensioner and idler pulleys

items.t: Height control suspension sags or rides hard
items.job: Replace height control spheres and flush suspension fluid
items.note: Converting to conventional springs and shocks costs about the same or more.

items.t: Torque converter failure on the 4-speed automatic
items.job: Replace torque converter or install remanufactured automatic transmission

items.t: Front CV joints click when turning
items.job: Replace front drive shaft (CV axle), one side

items.t: Plastic heater hose tees crack and leak coolant
items.job: Replace heater hose tees and hoses, refill coolant
items.note: A leaking heater core is a much bigger job (about 8 to 12 hours).

items.t: Power steering hoses and rack leak
items.job: Replace power steering return hoses or reseal steering rack

items.t: Starter clicks but won't crank
items.job: Replace starter (or starter contacts on the 4.7L)
items.note: The starter sits under the intake manifold on the V8s, so labor is high.

items.t: Secondary air injection pump or valve failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and air switching valve(s)
items.note: Owners of related Toyota V8s report bills from about $1,600 to over $3,000 at dealers.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may deploy on their own (recall)
items.job: Replace airbag control module

items.t: Blue smoke and burning oil
items.job: Replace valve stem seals (rings and engine rebuild cost far more)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $5,000 when deeper engine work was needed.

items.t: Radiator cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace radiator and refill coolant

items.t: Water pump leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and drive belt, refill coolant

items.t: Coolant leak from the valley plate at the back of the engine
items.job: Remove intake and replace valley coolant plate gasket
items.note: Owners report about $1,200 to $1,800 for this job alone.

items.t: Cam tower and timing cover oil leaks
items.job: Reseal cam towers and timing cover
items.note: One dealer quoted about $3,500 for roughly 17 hours of labor.

items.t: Clunk from the driveshaft when stopping or pulling away
items.job: Grease driveshaft joints; replace worn U-joints if needed

items.t: Passenger seat belt sensor wire can break and turn off airbags (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace front passenger seat belt assembly

items.t: Wrong front airbag may have been installed (recall)
items.job: Replace driver and/or passenger airbag

items.t: Rough or harsh shifting
items.job: Scan, update transmission software and reset shift learning

items.t: Front brakes squeal when backing up
items.job: Replace front brake pads, shims and anti-rattle springs per bulletin
items.note: Covered by Toyota for 3 years or 36,000 miles under the bulletin; outside that, pads and shim kits run about $100 to $200.

items.t: Fuel tube near the tank can come apart and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect fuel tube joint, add clamp or replace tube

items.t: Gauge screen can stay partly blank at startup (recall)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software

items.t: Backup camera can freeze or go blank (recall)
items.job: Update parking assist software

items.t: Harsh or jerky downshifts when slowing
items.job: Diagnose and update transmission software
items.note: Should be covered by warranty on these new trucks.

items.t: Transmission oil pump failure and limp mode
items.job: Replace transmission electric oil pump or transmission assembly
items.note: Owners report this being done under the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Sunroof or side glass shatters
items.job: Replace sunroof glass panel or door glass
items.note: Often handled through comprehensive insurance or goodwill.
